important_definition: neither_recorded is no qualifying recorded indoor/outdoor location, not physical inactivity
preference_definition: indoor exposure / (indoor exposure + outdoor exposure); both contributes one exposure to each side
preference_inference: Bayesian-bootstrap pairwise contrasts plus BH-FDR correction; low-n and non-estimable borough comparisons are retained and flagged

covid_scenarios.persistent_legacy: COVID-era level and time-since-COVID terms continue; no future disruption-window flag
covid_scenarios.legacy_recovery: future COVID-specific terms are set to zero; ordinary time trend and seasonality remain
